I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the project's recorded decision is Rustls as the TLS backend. The stated reasons are that it fits our Rust code better, has fewer CVEs, and is simpler.

Rustls is decision #21. An earlier decision (#7) chose OpenSSL. The catalog doesn't mark #21 as replacing #7. I treated #21 as current because it is newer and the session acknowledgement said it replaces the OpenSSL decision. The document doesn't mention OpenSSL.

The first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. Muninn also reports a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished, which may mean a hook is exceeding its timeout.
